talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $92.5M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, down 38% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Lemont Partners LLC (Birmingham, Other) targeting $20.4M. Good question to ask: are founders in other favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
O2 Auto Service Holdings, LLC disclosed a deal. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan private funds assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

5 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $76.8M raised so far — led by TCC MHP Holdings LLC (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
